answer: Each identity mints one marble per dawn from a device-bound key and stacks it on its ledge; voting weight equals stack height, capped at seven dawns. One device mints at most one marble per dawn window, so N fakes need N devices held seven dawns: 7N device-days before any can vote, and a missed dawn collapses the stack to zero. Two marbles from one key in one dawn voids both.
